}

thought: Cluster customers using k-medoids into truck_count groups (or fewer if more trucks than customers). Then solve TSP for each cluster with nearest neighbor and 2-opt. Balance max route distance via relocate moves from the longest to shortest routes. Use deterministic randomness with seed 0.
